note: Phase 2 authoritative execution manifest. Support-only unit decoder regressions, HTTP conformance, browser-request probes, smoke tests, and extra regressions stay outside this map.

ledger.title: Phase 2 Coverage Ledger
authoritative_execution: `backend-unit` selects authoritative `U-2-*` rows through `cartulary-runner.mjs go-target backend-unit`, with target-plan selection constrained by the Phase 2 manifest and `backend_unit` execution dependency.

`backend-store` selects store-backed authoritative `U-2-*` rows through `cartulary-runner.mjs go-target backend-store`, with target-plan selection constrained by the Phase 2 manifest and `backend_store` execution dependency.

`backend-integration` selects authoritative `I-2-*` rows through `cartulary-runner.mjs go-target backend-integration`, with target-plan selection constrained by the Phase 2 manifest and `backend_integration` execution dependency.
`frontend-unit` selects authoritative `U-2-*` rows only through the Phase 2 Vitest manifest for `frontend_unit`.

`tools/execution_topology_manifest.json` owns browser batch grouping and renders `tools/browser_e2e_batch_manifest.json` for Phase 2: `browser-e2e-webserver-backed` carries authoritative `E-2-*` rows through duration-balanced Playwright manifest-entry shards for `test` and `check`, while direct `browser-e2e-webserver-backed` and helper-only `browser-e2e-functional` select the same rows through manifest-driven `browser_functional` shard planning. Service-backed scheduling runs isolated browser evidence as leaf targets while direct `browser-e2e` remains the local aggregate for stateful, measurement, and visual browser batches.
support_execution_extras: `backend-integration-support` emits a shared-capture support report rather than a second independent runtime.
`make browser-e2e-support` is a helper slice also exercised inside the `browser-e2e-webserver-backed` browser batch and does not provide additional authoritative confirmation.
Phase 2 process smoke now runs as supplemental manifest coverage inside the `backend-process` execution family instead of a separate helper target.
shared_harness: | Public-route inventory ownership | `internal/testutil/phase2test.PublicRouteInventory()` owns the Phase 2 HTTP success-envelope inventory and is the source of truth for success status, CSRF expectation, envelope coverage, and mutation-owner metadata across Phase 2 owned routes. |

| Role-aware control boundary inventory | `internal/testutil/phase2test.ControlBoundaryInventory()` owns the incident-scoped control boundary matrix exercised by `I-2-03` and the deployment-admin-without-membership support sweep, including workbook-preference reads and writes, membership administration, Timeline or entity queries, lifecycle actions, and the websocket boundary. |

| Route inventory groups | The grouped helpers under `internal/testutil/phase2test` split public and control-boundary inventory by stable route family so backend integration shards stay independently schedulable as future phases add routes. |

| Owner-aware mutation helpers | `internal/testutil/phase2test.LookupOwnerMutations()`, `RequireOwnerMutationEvent()`, `CountMutationArtifacts()`, and `RequireNoMutationArtifacts()` keep Phase 2 tests tied to incident resource or membership mutation ownership on the current audit substrate instead of naming `deployment_admin_audit_events` directly. |

| Store-domain incident helpers | `internal/testutil/phase2storetest.StartStore()`, `SeedLocalUserRecord()`, `CreateIncidentInStore()`, `CreateMembershipInStore()`, `LookupUserByID()`, `LookupUserByEmail()`, and `SnapshotIncidentCreateReplaySideEffects()` keep Phase 2 store-backed unit rows aligned with the Phase 3 helper pattern instead of embedding one-off SQL in each test. |

| Reusable incident route fixture helpers | `internal/modules/incidents/phase2_inventory_helpers_test.go` centralizes the seeded incident, membership, and record fixture setup plus route execution helpers shared by the Phase 2 support and integration matrices. |

| Frontend ordinary-shell component coverage | `apps/web/src/App.landing.test.tsx` and `apps/web/src/IncidentAdminPanel.test.tsx` keep the authoritative frontend-unit evidence on the ordinary landing or incident shell rather than the debug-only `Phase2Harness`. |

| Audit-substrate follow-on | Phase 2 currently proves owner-level mutation attribution through the existing audit substrate only. Whether Phase 2 incident mutations should migrate onto `change_sets` is a separate owner decision and is not asserted by this ledger. |
support_only: `internal/modules/incidents/phase2_http_conformance_test.go::TestSupportPhase2_PublicRouteInventory*Envelopes` loops grouped `PublicRouteInventory*()` entries and proves the success-envelope contract stays attached to the shared inventory rather than scattered route lists.

`internal/modules/incidents/phase2_http_conformance_test.go::TestSupportPhase2_ControlBoundary*DeploymentAdminWithoutMembershipDenied` loops grouped `ControlBoundaryInventory*()` entries and proves deployment-admin-without-membership denial across the same incident-scoped surface that `I-2-03` re-derives through same-session role changes.

`internal/modules/incidents/phase2_request_test.go::TestSupportPhase2_WorkbookPreferencesPut*` and `TestSupportPhase2_OpenAPIWorkbookPreferencesExposeGetAndPutContracts` keep workbook-preference PUT decoder and contract-shape regressions on the executed `backend-unit` support surface.

`internal/modules/incidents/phase2_support_test.go::TestSupportPhase2Unit_MembershipPatchAndDeleteDecodeAndLastAdminGuardStayStable` keeps pure decoder-shape and `last_incident_admin` guard regression coverage on the executed `backend-unit` support surface. It does not replace `U-2-07`.

`internal/modules/incidents/phase2_extra_integration_test.go` keeps membership replay and before-or-after mutation payload regressions that strengthen confidence but do not replace the authoritative `I-2-*` rows.
`apps/web/e2e/phase2.support.spec.ts` and browser-authenticated request probes remain supplemental browser evidence for request-shape regressions and reserved-route behavior.
`apps/web/src/Phase2Harness.tsx` remains a debug-only probe surface behind `?debug=harness` and is not completion evidence.

unit.out_of_scope: Durable create persistence remains integration evidence.

unit.claim: The committed create result returns the stable `/api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}` location value.
unit.out_of_scope: Actual `Location` header emission remains support coverage.

unit.claim: Incident patch decode allows only promoted fields, requires `base_incident_version`, and keeps structural no-ops version-stable.

unit.claim: Store-backed membership patch and delete reject stale `base_membership_version` values without mutating durable membership state.

unit.claim: The incident access decision helper returns `incident_not_found` for no membership and `authorization_denied` for insufficient incident role.

unit.claim: Extension discovery keeps the singleton route shape, exact profile fields, canonical ordering, and no pagination members.
unit.out_of_scope: Runtime auth and leak checks remain integration evidence.

unit.claim: Reserved-family dispatch preserves base-route precedence, claimed-family routing, reserved-but-unclaimed canonical 404s, and ordinary outside-family 404s.

unit.title: Phase 2 U-2-13 ordinary incident shell issues membership create, patch, and delete requests with versioned payloads and refreshes session role after each mutation
unit.claim: The ordinary incident shell emits the expected membership mutation payloads, includes versioned patch or delete bodies, and refreshes the session-visible incident role after each mutation.
